phases.objective: Replace source-rewritten temporary test execution with a direct mounted Tenant route journey that reads the same canonical repository object before and after the exact successful request.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The direct mounted request completes the same operation in the same repository with immutable-plan consumption, append-only approvals, prepared/result/readback journals, reconciliation, and Tenant-safe readback without source rewriting or temporary test files.
steps: Create one synthetic Tenant operation, immutable plan, approval evidence, one-shot enablement, adapter, and canonical in-memory repository.
Mount the Tenant route with Context Kernel and effective-authority resolution bound to that exact operation.
Capture immutable plan bindings and approval digests from the canonical repository before the request.
Submit one expected-SHA-bound request to the mounted apply-plan endpoint.
Read the exact operation from the same repository object after the request and verify completion, plan consumption, journal phases, reconciliation, and Tenant-safe response binding.
Require the aggregate convergence gate to reject source-text rewriting and temporary generated test files.
Keep provider dispatch, live mutation, migration Apply, schema verification, deployment, Production readiness, and secrets disabled.
assertions: The shared-state gate executes the mounted route directly.
The repository object read before the request is the repository object read after the request.
Immutable plan bindings and append-only approval digests remain unchanged while single-use consumption advances.
Prepared, result, and readback journals and one reconciliation record bind to the same operation, run, plan, outcome, and result digest.
source_text_rewriting_used is false and temporary_test_file_created is false.
Provider dispatch, migration Apply, schema verification, Production readiness, and secrets remain false.

phases.objective: This bounded test refactor changes no operational runtime behavior or authority.
Unknown-outcome and restart resilience remain governed by their existing child contracts.
No live or non-production provider target is accessed by this test-only change.
This repository-only synthetic proof grants no Production authority.
